intro: Once points have cluster assignments, the least-squares center of each group is its mean. Empty clusters require a separate policy.
task: Re-estimate centroids from fixed assignments while preserving a previous center for any empty group.
requirements: points has shape (n,d), previous has shape (k,d), and labels is a matching vector of integer-valued cluster IDs in [0,k-1].
Return a new (k,d) matrix. For each nonempty cluster, average its assigned rows of points.
For an empty cluster, copy its corresponding previous center. Do not reassign points or renumber cluster IDs.

Use real finite numeric inputs with magnitude at most 1e6, excluding booleans. Vectors have length 1..128 and matrix axes have length 1..128 unless a tighter bound is stated. Leave all inputs unchanged; raise ValueError for invalid inputs.

hints.title: Find the structure
hints.body: Gather the rows for one cluster ID at a time; membership is supplied and stays fixed.

hints.title: Build the calculation
hints.body: Begin with a copy of previous centers so an empty group already has its specified fallback.

explanation: For fixed membership, differentiating the sum of squared distances with respect to a center gives the group mean. This is the update step of Lloyd-style k-means.
An empty group has no mean. Keeping its previous center makes the behavior explicit without silently changing the number or identity of clusters.
